scripts.db:reset: docker compose stop db && docker compose rm -f -v db
scripts.next:reset: docker compose stop next && docker compose rm -f -v next
scripts.app:reset: docker compose stop db next && docker compose rm -f -v db next
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/db run prisma:migrate:dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/db run prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.prisma:studio: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/db run prisma:studio
scripts.prisma:seed: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/db run seed
scripts.web:dev: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/web run dev
scripts.web:build: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/web run build
scripts.web:start: docker compose exec next npm -w @labatory/web run start
scripts.web:lint: npm -w @labatory/web run format && npm -w @labatory/web run lint:fix
scripts.web:lint:check: npm -w @labatory/web run format:check && npm -w @labatory/web run lint
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run next:up && npm run web:dev
